name: zerodrift
description: Enforcement for AI-written communication. Checks what Claude writes (emails, Slack and Teams messages, Google Drive documents, public web content) against your company policies before it is sent.

plugins.name: zerodrift
plugins.description: Catch compliance, PII and sensitive-data problems in AI-written messages and documents against your company policies before they go out. Checks Gmail and Slack sends automatically, and Outlook, Teams, Google Drive and public-web content when Claude drafts, replies or publishes.
